description:
Location: San Francisco, CA (onsite)
 Employment: Full-Time
 Experience: 0–6 years
 Compensation: $170K–$250K + Equity
 Equity: 0.5%–1.5%
 Openings: 3
 
 We’re working with an early-stage AI startup building intelligent software that automates complex, high-volume customer workflows across voice, SMS, and email .
 This is a true founding-level engineering opportunity for someone who wants significant ownership, moves quickly, and enjoys solving problems where there isn’t an established playbook.
 You’ll work across the full stack while helping build and scale production AI agents, integrations, and workflow systems.
 
 What You’ll Do: 
 As a Founding Engineer, you’ll have end-to-end ownership across product and infrastructure, including: 
 Build and scale production AI agents across voice, SMS, and email
 Design systems that maintain context and consistency across multi-channel interactions
 Develop full-stack product experiences and internal tools
 Build complex API integrations and custom adapters
 Work with external systems that may have limited or inconsistent APIs
 Develop scheduling and workflow orchestration systems
 Build infrastructure for scaling LLM-powered applications
 Improve agent state, memory, personalization, and reasoning
 Own features from problem definition → design → implementation → deployment → iteration 
 Troubleshoot production issues and make architectural decisions as the product evolves
 Work closely with the founding team to turn ambiguous problems into working products
 Requirements 
 We’re looking for a high-slope, highly ambitious engineer who wants substantial ownership early in their career. 
 
 Required:
 1–6 years of software engineering experience
 Strong TypeScript and Python experience
 Full-stack development experience
 Experience shipping real production software
 Strong software engineering and computer science fundamentals
 Experience owning projects or systems end-to-end
 Ability to make sound technical decisions with limited direction
 Comfortable working through ambiguous, technically challenging problems
 Strong understanding of the systems you’ve built and the architectural decisions behind them
 Demonstrated ability to learn quickly and take on new technologies
 Willingness to work in-person in San Francisco 6 days/week 
 Comfortable working in a highly demanding, fast-paced startup environment
 
 Strongly Preferred: 
 AI agents or production LLM applications
 LLM orchestration
 Voice AI
 SMS/email automation
 Conversational AI
 Agent state and memory
 Complex API integrations
 Reverse-engineering or integrating with legacy systems
 Scheduling or workflow systems
 Healthcare or other highly regulated industries
 High-volume communication platforms
 AWS
 Next.js
 TypeScript
 Python
 Open-source or significant personal projects
 Early-stage or founding startup experience
 
 What Makes This Role Different: 
 This isn't a role where you'll simply receive tickets and implement predefined requirements.
 You’ll be expected to figure things out, build, ship, break things, fix them, and improve them. 
 The ideal candidate can walk through something substantial they've built and clearly explain:
 What was the problem? → What did you build? → What did you personally own? → What were the hardest technical decisions? → What broke? → How did you fix it? → How did you scale it? 
 We're particularly interested in engineers who can demonstrate real-world impact , regardless of whether that experience came from a startup, previous employer, open-source project, or something they built independently.
 
 Ideal Background - You might be a: 
 Founding or early engineer at a startup
 Engineer #1–10 at an early-stage company
 Full-stack engineer building AI-powered products
 New or recent CS graduate with exceptional technical projects
 Software engineer who has independently built and shipped products
 Engineer with experience integrating complex or difficult external systems
 Years of experience are less important than demonstrated ability to build. 
 A candidate with 1–2 years of experience who has genuinely owned and shipped a difficult production system may be a strong fit.
 
 Technology: TypeScript • Python • AWS • Next.js • LLMs • AI Agents • APIs • Voice • SMS • Email • Full-Stack 
 
 Work Environment: This is an in-person, high-intensity startup environment in San Francisco. 
 The team moves quickly, expects a high degree of ownership, and is looking for engineers who are excited by ambitious goals and a demanding pace.
 Schedule: 6 days/week
 Weekdays: 10 AM–9 PM
 Sixth day: 12 PM–7 PM
 
 Interested? 
 If you're excited about building AI products from the ground up and want a role where you can have significant technical ownership early in your career, we'd love to hear from you.
 Please include: 
 Resume
 LinkedIn
 GitHub
 Current location
 Brief overview of the most meaningful production system or project you've personally built
 Benefits 
 Compensation: $170K–$250K + Equity
 Equity: 0.5%–1.5%
 Comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance
 PTO
 401(k) retirement plan
 High-ownership environment with direct access to leadership
 Opportunity to make a significant impact at an early-stage AI startup
